answer: A concrete defense is bonded identity: every agent locks a collateral stake and accumulates a public reputation thread of signed service receipts. Peers weight transactions by stake times reputation, so each sybil identity must post its own fresh stake — one grain per dune — while honest agents compound trust. If a cluster is caught colluding, its bonds are slashed and burned. This makes the attacker's voyage of mass fake accounts uneconomical: per-identity cost exceeds any expected payoff.
